source_name: U.S. Census Bureau 119th Congressional District to 2020 ZCTA Relationship File
vintage: 119th Congress districts related to 2020 Census ZCTAs
effective_date_or_limitation: 119th Congress / 2020 ZCTA vintage; Census presents a congressional-session and geography vintage, not one exact address-lookup effective date.
license_or_terms_basis: Official U.S. Census Bureau public data published as open government data; Census Bureau works created by employees generally are not subject to U.S. copyright. Retrieval required no credentials or terms acceptance.
known_limitations: ZIP Codes are USPS delivery-route constructs, while ZCTAs are Census-created areal approximations.
ZCTAs do not represent every valid USPS ZIP Code.
A ZCTA can overlap more than one district and the file can contain non-ZCTA remainder rows.
ZIP/ZCTA-only results can surface possible districts but cannot establish address-level representation.
Current House member metadata and duplicate-member gates are not evaluated by this source file.
